dex.entry: A tiny round tidepool creature that rolls with the surf, collecting trinkets in a dimpled shell-belly. Scouts ahead with quick darting bursts. Endearingly pudgy and curious — kids love how it collects bits of the beach in its belly-dip.

art.silhouette: Plump oval body, translucent blue-grey with a pale underbelly, two bright bead eyes, stubby flipper-feet, and a dimpled concave belly-shell that catches pebbles and seaweed bits. Readable at 16px.
